cases.explain: «ливанские кедры» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: Now therefore command that cedar trees be cut for me out of Lebanon. My servants will be with your servants; and I will give you wages for your servants according to all that you say. For you know that there is nobody among us who knows how to cut timber like the Sidonians.”

cases.sentence: А ты исполнишь мое желание, поставляя продовольствие для моего ___».
cases.explain: «царского дома» — after the preposition «для», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: My servants will bring them down from Lebanon to the sea. I will make them into rafts to go by sea to the place that you specify to me, and will cause them to be broken up there, and you will receive them. You will accomplish my desire, in giving food for my household.”

cases.sentence: Так Хирам поставлял Соломону кедровое и кипарисовое дерево, сколько тот хотел, 11 а Соломон давал Хираму двадцать тысяч коров пшеницы для его дома, не считая двадцати тысяч батов ___.
cases.explain: «оливкового масла» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: So Hiram gave Solomon cedar timber and cypress timber according to all his desire.

cases.explain: «подневольными рабочими» — after the preposition «за», the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: He sent them to Lebanon, ten thousand a month by courses; for a month they were in Lebanon, and two months at home; and Adoniram was over the men subject to forced labor.

cases.sentence: По повелению царя они добывали большие ___, чтобы заложить основание дома из тесаного камня.
cases.explain: «дорогие камни» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: The king commanded, and they cut out large stones, costly stones, to lay the foundation of the house with worked stone.
